title: Django — Draft final assessment blueprint
purpose: Repository-side assessment specification for future review and exam delivery integration. This does not indicate that CodeLeaf currently supports live Django exams or certificates.

outcome_distribution.outcome: Understand project setup, request lifecycle, routing, views, templates
Model data, use ORM, migrations, transactions and admin
Validate input, protect access, build APIs, test application behavior
Address security, performance, deployment and advanced architecture

remediation: Review the lesson linked to each missed objective and complete its practice task before retrying.
grading: Draft blueprint: no course-specific grading route is claimed to be active. A future implementation must grade on the server and protect answer keys.
status_note: Draft only. Passing score and attempt count are proposed curriculum settings and require product/assessment review. Certificate issuance is not implemented by this blueprint.
